title: Digit Scaling Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Text Rendering
Scaled Digits
Bitmap Fonts
OLED
description: Scale an 8 by 8 font up to 6 times on a 128 by 64 OLED preview and see when the text becomes too wide for the screen.

learningObjectives: Apply the scale factor to compute text width as 8 x scale x characters
Analyze the tradeoff between digit size and how many characters fit
prerequisites: The 8 by 8 built-in font and text() (Chapter 12)
Pixel coordinates on the 128 by 64 OLED (Chapter 11)

keyQuestions: How tall is a digit at scale 6, and does it fit vertically?
Why do the scaled digits look blocky instead of smooth?
commonMisconceptions: Scaling a bitmap font adds detail (it only makes the same pixels bigger)
Text that runs off the edge wraps to the next line (framebuf simply clips it)
assessmentOpportunities: The student computes 5 x 24 = 120 pixels for 12:34 at scale 3.
The student states the largest scale for an 8-character string (scale 2).
The student explains why scaled digits look blocky.
